Covers every section 6.1-6.12 in order (enthalpy change, energy profile, standard enthalpy changes, bond energies, calorimetry, calorie content, Hess's law and its applications, energetics of solution, Born-Haber cycle, entropy, free energy). Numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: SO₄²⁻ (not SO₄²⁺), solubility of Group II sulphates decreases, lattice energy is negative (released), specific heat of water is per gram, calorie content of glucose +3.72 kcal/g, entropy increase alone does not make CaCO₃ decomposition spontaneous, 436 + 242 = 678 kJ, Sample 6.8 finds ΔH°sol.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
